## Rule-date anchor (primary-source verified 8/2/2026)

- 47 CFR 64.2011 (CPNI breach notification) was adopted in the 2007 CPNI Order, published 72 FR 31948 (June 8, 2007). The DATES section states 64.2010/64.2011 were NOT effective on publication (pending OMB approval).
- FCC compliance guidance (DA-08-1321, June 6, 2008) states the EPIC CPNI Order rules, including 64.2011, became effective December 8, 2007.
- "September 28, 2007" has no primary-source referent found in the Federal Register or FCC documents and is RETIRED (see STALE_RESULTS_MANIFEST).

| Cutoff | Pre-rule obs (regression sample) | Pre-rule treated |
|---|---|---|
| Calendar-2007 cutoff (basis of canonical "4 pre-2007" claim) | 4 | 1 |
| FR-verified effective date of 47 CFR 64.2011 (Dec 8, 2007) | 10 | 1 |
